approval.verdict: Encode this exact email as a gold exemplar; shortening, professionalizing or sales personalization is usually a regression.

subject: Possible project with Global Fishing Watch
body:
Hi David,

I’m a UofT student currently on co-op in London working on search, planning and simulation problems for a biotech automation company, mostly building systems that search large state spaces for failures and recovery paths, along with simulation and optimization tooling around them. Outside of work I’ve also done a fair bit with RL and MCTS.

I’ve wanted to find a way to use that skillset on ocean conservation for a while, and Global Fishing Watch felt like a particularly good fit given how much of the work comes down to reasoning from incomplete data and trying to understand behaviour over time.

I was wondering if there might be a small contract project I could take ownership of alongside my current work. One thought was a simulation and evaluation harness around historical vessel behaviour to test models or monitoring systems against AIS gaps, ambiguous tracks, identity issues and unusual activity around protected areas, but I’d much rather work on whatever problem would actually be useful to the research team.

I attached my resume for context; happy to jump on a quick call if there might be something worth exploring.

Best,
Andrew
traits: Search large state spaces for failures and recovery paths
AIS gaps, ambiguous tracks and identity issues
Small contract project I could take ownership of
Recipient can redirect to useful work
